title: Boundary Logic with Credit Data: Loan-Default Prediction
text: vignette walks complete three-phase Boundary Logic workflow credit-risk problem: predicting loan default dataset 45,000 loan applications binary loan_status outcome (1 = default, 0 = repaid). closes section places Boundary Logic’s interpretation side side SHAP model. loan dataset exercises features simple iris example : non-linear, tree-based model — XGBoost classifier, wrapped via bl_wrap_model(). Domain filtering — credit-risk question posed sub-population applicants prior default file. Feature pruning driven Phase 2 — global distance--boundary importance used drop weak variables refit leaner model. Business-motivated actionability constraints — variables (interest rate, credit score) move defined directions; others (age) fixed. External-applicant analysis — scoring explaining brand new application training data. workflow follows three phases: Phase 1: Data preparation, model fitting, CVA biplot construction. Phase 2: Global interpretation — distance boundary, per-variable importance, surrogate model, feature pruning. Phase 3: Local interpretation single applicant — local counterfactual, Shapley attribution, sparse counterfactual. Comparison SHAP: global local SHAP XGBoost model, contrasted Boundary Logic output.

Three high-cardinality categoricals (loan_intent, person_education, person_home_ownership) dropped keep biplot legible. code: loan_raw <- read.csv(   system.file("extdata", "loan_data.csv", package = "boundarylogic") )  loan_encoded <- loan_raw  gender_map    <- c(female = 0, male = 1) ownership_map <- c("MORTGAGE" = 0, "OTHER" = 1, "OWN" = 2, "RENT" = 3) intent_map    <- c("DEBTCONSOLIDATION" = 0, "EDUCATION" = 1,                    "HOMEIMPROVEMENT" = 2, "MEDICAL" = 3,                    "PERSONAL" = 4, "VENTURE" = 5) education_map <- c("High School" = 0, "Associate" = 1,                    "Bachelor" = 2, "Master" = 3, "Doctorate" = 4) defaults_map  <- c("No" = 0, "Yes" = 1)  loan_encoded$person_gender                  <- gender_map[loan_encoded$person_gender] loan_encoded$person_education               <- education_map[loan_encoded$person_education] loan_encoded$person_home_ownership          <- ownership_map[loan_encoded$person_home_ownership] loan_encoded$loan_intent                    <- intent_map[loan_encoded$loan_intent] loan_encoded$previous_loan_defaults_on_file <- defaults_map[loan_encoded$previous_loan_defaults_on_file]  # Coerce all columns to double so the training data and the prediction grid # share the same type (read.csv() reads integer-valued columns as integer, # but the grid builder generates sequences as double). loan_encoded[] <- lapply(loan_encoded, as.numeric)  # Drop high-cardinality categoricals vars_to_remove <- c("loan_intent", "person_education", "person_home_ownership") loan_encoded   <- loan_encoded[, setdiff(names(loan_encoded), vars_to_remove),                                drop = FALSE]  names(loan_encoded) #>  [1] "person_age"                     "person_gender"                  #>  [3] "person_income"                  "person_emp_exp"                 #>  [5] "loan_amnt"                      "loan_int_rate"                  #>  [7] "loan_percent_income"            "cb_person_cred_hist_length"     #>  [9] "credit_score"                   "previous_loan_defaults_on_file" #> [11] "loan_status"

text: bl_prepare_data() makes reproducible 80/20 split, encodes class, trims outermost 10% training points (hull_fraction = 0.9). XGBoost classifier fitted directly registered bl_wrap_model() using built-"XGB" dispatch — model must supplied list(model = <booster>, features = <character vector>). CVA projection default workflow: maximises -class separation 2D plane, making decision boundary clearly visible. text: best eigenvector pair selected minimum distance target nearest valid boundary vertex. Two distance metrics available: "mahalanobis" (default) Squared Mahalanobis distance original X-space using within-class covariance matrix \(W\) stored bl_result$metric_inv: \(d_M^2 = v^T W^{-1} v\) \(v = B_x - x_{obs}\). invariant eigenvector pair chosen mathematically sound default – measures within-class noise units regardless 2D rotated slice produced counterfactual.
